original.target_description: Study 1: Dettol perceived efficacy, multiple bottles versus single bottle. Accepted full primary paper unavailable; secondary report and publisher search-index excerpt were not substituted for the original paper.

replication.target_description: Replication 1 of original Study 1: MTurk participants rated perceived effectiveness of Dettol after an ad with five bottles versus one bottle; composite of four 9-point items. MTurk participants with >90% approval rating.

n.sample_role: Participants: N explicitly printed for the target comparison in the results figure; analytic N uncertain because exclusion table conflicts.
n.exclusions: Starting N = 853; sequential exclusions for no HIT submission, smartphone, duplicate MTurk ID, duplicate IP address, unanswered attention check and failed attention check. Exclusions table ends at 634, whereas target results figure prints N = 636.
